sourceContext.binding: Exact local file bytes, not checkout HEAD alone, bind the graph. The unchanged package dependency matches the selected main base.

sourceReview.importClosure: Status module imports nothing. Planner imports only status. The three selected unit files import only node:test, node:assert/strict and the paired modules.
sourceReview.coverage: Canonical bounded JSON, exact identity/schema/label/cost/cache binding, non-authorizing immutable projections, uncertainty precedence/latches, terminal and cache monotonicity, atomic rejections, strict arities and idempotent local close/no reset.
sourceReview.limits: Declared model DTO subset and coherent labels do not authenticate hashes, original bytes, backend state, custody or effects. Pristine JSON/Object/string intrinsics remain premises.

runtime.name: Node.js
runtime.premises: Native loader, runner, streams, OS behavior, pristine intrinsics and source-to-import race freedom remain premises.
